facts.text: Volvo CE Collision Mitigation System launched in January 2023, with a new generation in April 2025.

facts.text: Volvo CE Collision Mitigation System uses slope memory to avoid activation at stockpiles.
facts.quote: Slope memory to avoid stockpile activation
